# AGI OS

> AGI OS is an Arch Linux live ISO with an AI agent inside. You describe the system you want in plain words, try the real system in a live preview, and install it to your computer when you like it. Free and open source under the Apache 2.0 license.

- Software comes from the official Arch Linux repositories (core and extra).
- Works with ChatGPT sign-in, OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, Ollama for local models and any OpenAI-compatible endpoint. API keys never enter the chat and are never copied to the installed system.
- Nothing on the disk changes until the user confirms the install. Tested in virtual machines on 64-bit PCs; real hardware is experimental. Dual boot is not supported yet.

## Start

- [Install](https://agios.complexity.solutions/install): download the Live ISO, check its SHA-256, write it to a USB stick or boot it in a VM
- [Getting started](https://agios.complexity.solutions/docs): from a downloaded ISO to an installed system in six steps

## Docs

- [Live environment](https://agios.complexity.solutions/docs/live-environment): what the ISO contains
- [Reversible preview](https://agios.complexity.solutions/docs/reversible-preview): the preview is the real installed system, and it can be taken back
- [Agent and privacy](https://agios.complexity.solutions/docs/agent-and-privacy): what the agent can and cannot see
- [Providers](https://agios.complexity.solutions/docs/providers): which models and agents connect
- [Preview placement](https://agios.complexity.solutions/docs/preview-placement): where the preview is stored
- [Disks and boot](https://agios.complexity.solutions/docs/disks-and-boot): filesystems, bootloaders, encryption, current limits
- [FAQ](https://agios.complexity.solutions/docs/faq)
- [AGI OS vs archinstall](https://agios.complexity.solutions/docs/vs-archinstall): how it compares to the official Arch guided installer
- [Contribute](https://agios.complexity.solutions/docs/contribute)
